document.title: Releasing sxml
document.p: How a release is cut. The owner tags it and publishes it, and agents prepare everything up to that point (). The first public release is 0.2.0, made at the end of Phase 2 (PLAN.md, phase 2 gate).

section.title: What a version promises
section.p: sxml follows Semantic Versioning (include/sxml/version.h). The public headers (include/sxml/) are stable from 0.2.0 on ():

item.p: A release that only adds declarations raises the minor version (the patch version for fixes that add nothing). It also raises SXML_API_VERSION to the release that added them.

A release that changes or removes a declaration needs a decision record in docs/DECISIONS.md. Before 1.0.0 it raises the minor version, and from 1.0.0 the major version. The changelog lists the change under "Changed" or "Removed".
The frozen substrate headers () change only additively, and each change has a record.
xquery.h, xslt.h and schema.h were provisional until the Phase 3, 4 and 5 gates (, ) and are stable since (, , ).

section.p: The JavaScript package (bindings/javascript/) has the same version as the library. Its API grows only additively within a minor version, as the headers do.

item.p: Gate. The phase gate's boxes in docs/tasks/ are ticked, except the box for the tag.
Version. Set the same version in four places:
SXML_VERSION_MAJOR, _MINOR and _PATCH in include/sxml/version.h, and SXML_API_VERSION when the release adds declarations;
the expected version in tests/version_test.c, tests/cli/expected/version_*.stdout and bindings/javascript/test/package.test.ts.
Changelog. In CHANGELOG.md, the section for the release gets the date in place of "unreleased", and its link at the bottom names the tag.
Build and test from a clean tree. The definition of done (CLAUDE.md) must hold:
item.pre: for preset in debug debug-gcc wasm release; do cmake --preset $preset && cmake --build --preset $preset && ctest --preset $preset done tools/lint.sh npm ci --prefix bindings/javascript && ctest --preset wasm -R javascript
item.p: javascript/size_budget must pass (, ). Regenerate docs/CONFORMANCE.md () and quote its XP40 line in the release notes.
Commit the version and the changelog as "Release X.Y.Z", then push to main.

Tag (owner): git tag -a vX.Y.Z -m "sxml X.Y.Z", then git push origin vX.Y.Z. Create a GitHub release from the tag with the changelog section as its notes. Attach sxml.wasm and the package tarball from step 7.
Publish the JavaScript package (owner). Do this from the tagged commit:
item.pre: cmake --preset wasm && cmake --build --preset wasm --target sxml_javascript_module cd bindings/javascript npm ci SXML_WASM_PATH=../../build/wasm/bindings/javascript/sxml.wasm npm run build npm pack # check the tarball: dist/*.js, dist/*.d.ts, dist/sxml.wasm, dist/allkeys.txt npm publish # needs the npm account and the package name
item.p: The npm name sxml belongs to another project. The package is named @tinyactors/sxml ().
After the release, open a new "unreleased" section in CHANGELOG.md.
